name: atoma
description: Start and continue Atoma projects, follow runs, and inspect results, costs and traces.

interface.shortDescription: Build software and follow your Atoma runs.
interface.longDescription: Connect to Atoma to draft goals and acceptance criteria, start or continue project runs, and inspect their status, deliverables, costs and traces. Available tools depend on your account role. Starting a run uses your Atoma quota.
defaultPrompt: Show my Atoma projects and their latest runs.
Help me draft a goal for an Atoma project.
